ValidationRule.description: A record must be owned by a Queue if the related Subscriber or IER records are to be set to Private, because a Queue is the mechanism for giving access to these records for the staff that should be able to see it.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A record must be owned by a Queue if the Subscriber or IER records are set to Private. If you do not have access to a team Queue, contact your Salesforce administrator to help with setting up a Queue that will allow your team access to private records.
